messages:
Maria Lopez: Heads up — Partner Nimbus asked for a private offer that frontloads credits (heavy in months 1–3) tied to a 12mo committed spend. They want pricing, SKU mapping, and a joint announcement cadence by next Tue. CC @Dave @Sara :wave:
Dave Chen: Do we have a precedent for front-loaded credits on marketplace private offers? I recall a similar ask last year but want the numbers. :thinking_face:
Sara Patel: We ran a pilot with 30% month1 credit for >$500k commit, 15% for mid-tier. Legal flagged public wording once. We can propose tiered frontload: 30/20/10 over first 3 months depending on commit band.
Ian O'Neill: Ops note — Dedicated pools can support burst for the ramp but need SKU pinning. I'll draft SKU -> instance-type mapping and capacity guardrails.
Maria Lopez: Timeline: draft offer + marketplace listing copy by EOD Fri, internal review Mon, partner sign-off Tue. Who owns the listing text? Also plan for an embargoed joint blog + partner co-sell emails 1 week after go-live.
Dave Chen: I can assemble pricing math. Quick sketch below (will formalize):
```
// simple calc
commit = 600000
frontload_pct = 0.30
frontload_credit = commit * frontload_pct
monthly_remainder = (commit - frontload_credit) / 11
```
Sara Patel: I'll loop in Legal and Field comms. Note: avoid terms like "unlimited burst" in marketplace blurb. Use "reserved burst capacity subject to license" instead.
partner-bot: exported private-offer-draft://nimbus-2024-frontload-v1.json to /internal/offers (ID: po-7721) :white_check_mark:
Maria Lopez: Perfect — Dave + Ian will sync on SKU and pricing today. Sara, can you confirm legal by Monday 10am? If yes, I'll send partner the embargoed announcement assets schedule.
Dave Chen: Yep. I'll post the pricing sheet link in #partnerships-updates once done.
Sara Patel: Confirmed — I'll escalate to Legal now. Ping me if there are any unusual indemnities. :thumbsup:
Ian O'Neill: Adding a quick TODO: map SKU to Dedicated pool, add fallback to r4-small for emergency, and add autoscale guard (max qps). I'll attach the mapping by EOD.
Maria Lopez: Thanks team — short sync at 3pm if needed. :calendar:
